proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ a b c a' b' c' r _ _ hr h1 h2 h3
  have hs : Similar ![a, b, c] ![a', b', c'] := by
    refine similar_iff_exists_pos_dist_eq.mpr ⟨r, hr, fun i j => ?_⟩
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp <;> grind [dist_comm]
  exact ⟨hs, hs.angle_eq_all⟩
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (a b c a' b' c' : P) (r : ℝ), ¬Collinear ℝ ({a, b, c} : Set P) → ¬Collinear ℝ ({a', b', c'} : Set P) → 0 < r → dist a b = r * dist a' b' → dist b c = r * dist b' c' → dist c a = r * dist c' a' → Similar ![a, b, c] ![a', b', c'] ∧ EuclideanGeometry.angle a b c = EuclideanGeometry.angle a' b' c' ∧ EuclideanGeometry.angle b c a = EuclideanGeometry.angle b' c' a' ∧ EuclideanGeometry.angle c a b = EuclideanGeometry.angle c' a' b'
